array.string: export CRAFT_RPC_CLI=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -c "import json,os;print(json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.craft-agent/runtime/self-healing/persistent-controller.json')))['rpcCli'])"); export CRAFT_SERVER_URL=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -c "import json,os;print(json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.craft-agent/runtime/self-healing/persistent-controller.json')))['serverUrl'])"); export CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN=$(cat ~/.config/craft-agent-headless/server-token); /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 ~/.craft-agent/scripts/owner-gate-board.py sync --apply
